body:
Follow-ups found while reviewing #476. None of these block the PR's architecture; each one was verified against `7a595bf`.

### 1. `--workflow-endpoint` + `--task-endpoint` is now refused
`internal/host/routes.go:111` still writes the task endpoint URL into `TaskRoute.Environment`, which used to be a display label. After #476, any non-empty `Route.Environment` means "orchestrated named environment". `internal/runner/runner.go:48` rejects it when the connection has no messaging, and so does `effects.Call` (`internal/effects/client.go`). The `http` backend only returns `Execution`, so the remote runner refuses this combination at startup.

Fix: stop putting the endpoint into `Environment`, or give the placement label a separate field.

### 2. Execution-route daemons have no `SecretsBackend`
`serveEnvironmentOptions` (`cmd/gimbal/daemon.go:29`, also used for Docker) and the registered `local` backend (`internal/invocation/invocation.go:51`) build `taskdaemon.New()` without setting `Secrets`. On those routes, `WithYields` with names fails with "producer requires a secrets backend" and `WithRequirements` fails with "requirements need a secrets backend". Either wire in a store or reject these declarations up front with a route-level error.

### 3. Leftover URL-service topology
- `taskdaemon.Daemon.PublicHost` is set (`cmd/gimbal/daemon.go:31`) but never read, because its only reader `Daemon.service` was deleted.
- The Docker plugin still validates and publishes `ServicePorts`/`PublicHost` ("published services require PublicHost reachable by their consumer").
- The `gimbal environment` help text still describes "URL-returning services" and says "Start means launched, not ready; workflows check readiness". Both contradict the new contract.

### 4. `WithYields` carries over to every later operation on the context
After `ctx = gimbal.WithYields(ctx, "", "X")`, every later `RunCommand`/`Service` on that ctx becomes a producer. An unrelated `RunCommand(ctx, "x", "", "true")` then fails with `producer output file unavailable` and fails the scope (confirmed with a probe test). Proposed lint rule: `WithYields` may only appear inline as the ctx argument of `Service`/`RunCommand`/`Check`.

comments.body: Split into the new tracking issues: items 1–3 are now part of #480 and item 4 is part of #481.

title: Follow-ups from #476: endpoint routes, daemon secrets wiring, leftover service topology
